Subject: Post-demo — security kickoff & questionnaire preference

Thanks for the demo earlier — great conversation. We discussed next steps with security and procurement, and I'd like to kick off that process. A few quick items from our side: 

- Novellum Health is moving forward with a pilot and needs to complete vendor security vetting before procurement approval.
- Current compliance posture: SOC 2 Type II in progress (targeting September 2026 report). We do have some controls in place now.
- We process limited PHI in the pilot (patient identifiers + appointment data) and will need HIPAA assurances / BAA.

Questions for Redwood: 
1) Do you recommend we prefill your SIG or the CAIQ? We can do either but want to minimize duplication.
2) For HIPAA, do you have a standard BAA and any additional attestation for PHI handling?
3) Are there region/residency notes we should be aware of for US-only data?

I've attached the initial security intake PDF that procurement asked us to send to prospective vendors (Novellum_SIG_Request.pdf). Can you confirm the preferred intake form and a rough timeline for when Redwood can provide a completed prefill or a SOC2 evidence bundle?

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20–30 min call if easier.

Best,
Avery Lim
Head of IT Security
Novellum Health

Thanks Avery — appreciate the summary and the attachment. Quick recap and preferred path from Redwood: 

Recap: SOC2 Type II targeted Sept 2026, pilot will process PHI (HIPAA scope), procurement wants vendor intake.

Recommended path: 
- Primary: We typically do a SIG prefill (RDW_SIG_Prefill.xlsx) for faster turnaround because it covers our operational controls and is widely accepted by cloud buyers.
- If Novellum has HIPAA-specific narrative/controls beyond SIG, we can augment the prefill with a short custom addendum (we've done this for other health customers).
- If your procurement requires a CAIQ specifically, we can provide that too — CAIQ vs SIG is mostly a mapping exercise on our side.

Clarifying questions so we can scope work and timelines: 
1) Can you confirm the exact data types and whether Novellum will be a Business Associate under HIPAA? (BAA yes/no)
2) Expected go-live for the pilot and any procurement deadlines?
3) Any strict data residency or flow diagrams we need to include (US-only, specific cloud provider regions)?
4) Who should we send the evidence bundle to (security@novellumhealth.com or procurement@novellumhealth.com)?

Next steps I propose: 
- I'll attach a prefill template (RDW_SIG_Prefill.xlsx) and a short checklist; if you confirm PHI/BAA we will queue a HIPAA addendum.
- Marissa (cc'd) will own evidence collection and can coordinate with your security team on doc delivery and secure links.
- If Novellum prefers a call, we can do 20–30 minutes tomorrow (Fri) morning PT and aim to have a prefilled SIG back within 3 business days after we get your answers and contact for evidence.

Attaching: RDW_SIG_Prefill.xlsx (excel)

Thanks,
Priyom Das
